description: Give the user the Dozo PDF tool they need, on dozokit.com: merge (several PDFs into one), compress (make a PDF smaller), split (by page ranges), jpg_to_pdf (images into one PDF), sign, organize (reorder, rotate, delete pages). The user picks the files there and they never leave their device. Files already attached to this conversation cannot be used. Read-only. Donne le lien vers l’outil PDF : les fichiers restent sur l’appareil.
